what: Kalshi market-making holdout scored on a sample that is EVENT-disjoint from the tuning cache and stratified by close week, at 1-minute resolution.

overlap.verified_by: raw json.load of both cache files in this script, not through mm_backtest._load_excluded_events -- the harness's own filter is not evidence about the harness's own filter

week_supply.natural_draw_note: a single random.sample(remaining, n_collected) at seed 20260912, drawn at the SAME size as the stratified sample actually collected so the two columns are comparable -- one draw, not an expectation
week_supply.cv_note: coefficient of variation of the per-week counts over EVERY week the post-exclusion universe holds (weeks a draw misses count as 0); 0.0 would be perfectly flat

universe.printed_by: the collection run's own stdout: 'excluded 33213 markets belonging to one of 7297 events already collected in .cache/mm/kalshi-60m.json; 17257 remain'

fees.note: the rebate is never added to any P&L (GUARDRAILS.md 2.3); it is reported as its own line

split_exclusions.detail: events with markets closing on both sides of the cutoff keep their pre-cutoff markets in train and have their post-cutoff markets dropped, so no test market shares an event with a train market. Those rows remain in `overall`.
